data: What is the approximate accuracy drop in BLEU score for the De-En (En) translation task based on the ∆RF3 in graph(a)?

The question asks for the approximate accuracy drop in BLEU score for the De-En (En) translation task based on the ∆RF3 in graph(a). 

From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the gap of between the left and right ratio of the 3-gram frequency/conditional probability, and the y-axis represents the accuracy drop in terms of BLEU score.

In graph(a), the blue line represents the relationship between the accuracy drop and the ∆RF3. The De-En (En) translation task is labeled at approximately 20% on the x-axis. By following the blue line up to this point, we can estimate the corresponding y-axis value, which represents the accuracy drop in BLEU score.

Looking at the graph, the De-En (En) translation task appears to have an accuracy drop of approximately -1.5 BLEU points.
